Source/emitted warning limits remain explicit:22new geometry-carry warnings plus3existing Kerr-infinity initialization and3existing derivative warnings; no blanket warning cure/suppression. Current backend+trace3 are byteidentical to the already successful original Linux witness and reused.

Original nativeAMD all3rung Jacobi case passed with complete numerical,retention/restart,input/module/ownership checks. A different original coupledFP64 case failed pipeline creation before its first numerical packet; shutdown was audited and source remains unchanged. That failure is preserved separately and does not weaken original assertions/budgets or admit full science. Clang/sanitizers/full1152Mandatory/eight externaldomains/install/relocation/readiness/main/release remain pending. PR62 remains unmerged.

---

Current source `f22dc025` passes all three requested integration jobs in [CI 38776590607](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/actions/runs/38776590607). Windows and macOS each executed the original nine-case native-build gate with zero failures/errors/skips and retained all 1,152 registrations. Five unrequested qualification jobs were skipped. The repository attestation verifier and independent product/archive reviews passed for both platforms. [Published 304-file preservation](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/c8bc52bbea5fd0e4b1a56b42bd1f2af3770eddc8/attestations/qualification/f22dc025/native-build-ci-38776590607) retains all 227 artifact members, 46 raw-log members and publication joins. Six ZIP container encodings are explicitly omitted; their exact members and API/container digests are preserved.

The current Windows diagnostic archive contains all 138 manifest payloads, including the genuine current backend joined to its passed native-build gate. Of the 63 registration/install exports, 62 remain byte-identical to `e0db7d59`; the installation verifier differs only by its source-revision literal. The macOS registration difference is the expected three-line trace-test source-location shift; names, commands and governors remain unchanged. The configured Python alias still records zero bytes with a target digest; it is not an interpreter backup or substitution authority.

These are build/integration results. Compiled external-domain admission remains 0/8, with runtime readiness false. Full Mandatory, native graphics/MoltenVK, scientific, cold-frame, performance, UI and installed-release acceptance remain open. Current numerical witnesses and the separately bounded trace RSS stop are tracked in #53.

Prior entry retained verbatim (last updated 2026-10-15 16:20 UTC; describes `e0db7d59`):

Current source `e0db7d59` passes all three requested integration jobs in [CI 38754177960](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/actions/runs/38754177960). Windows and macOS each executed the original nine-case native-build gate with zero failures/errors/skips; all 1,152 registrations remain present. Five unrequested qualification/sanitizer/retained jobs were skipped. The original attestation verifier passed for both platforms, as did the independent artifact/product review. [Exact 296-file CI preservation](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/d0662d27ef039c2a83aa43f6e7df57cd89f9fe76/attestations/qualification/e0db7d59/native-build-ci-38754177960) retains all 227 downloaded artifact members and the raw CI logs; omission of the five redundant ZIP encodings is explicit.

The configured Windows export is now implemented and preserved: 63 original registration/install payloads, their metadata, the complete saved inventory, strict compiled CLI/backend volumes, CRT and staged SDK loader. The current local diagnostic stage has exactly 140 files, with both executables joined to the passed native gate. Cross-revision comparison finds 62 exported payloads byte-identical and one installation verifier changed only by its required source-revision literal. The configured Python alias still records Length 0 with its target digest; this is not admission of a replacement executable or a full compilerless Mandatory stage.

All eight focused software numerical controls passed separately on this source, including actual FP32/compensated-FP32/FP64 conservation. [Exact software evidence](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/2c419ad2f420a50ebb6cc92c37ef0cc30927a63d/attestations/scientific-core/e0db7d59/kerr-cartdelta-rhs-source-and-software-controls) preserves the original assertions, diagnostic guards and explicit LVP setting. These finite checks and the build records do not establish full Mandatory execution, native runtime/MoltenVK/UI/scientific/performance/release acceptance. Compiled alignment remains qualification with 0/8 admitted domains. Native numerical qualification is being tracked separately in #53.

Prior entry retained below (last updated 2026-10-15 11:44 UTC; describes `ed764546`):

Current source `ed764546` passes [CI 38724081383](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/actions/runs/38724081383) on Linux, Windows and macOS. Both native-build gates ran 9/9 with zero failures/errors/skips and 1,152 registrations. Independent comparison preserves every prior 1,150 name, label and timeout and adds exactly the two intended Mandatory Kerr regressions. All 155 downloaded artifact members and the 76-file Windows diagnostic stage match their API/archive/product identities. [173-file CI preservation](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/86c368e55380247a7854493cb86a721259a7ce53/attestations/qualification/ed764546/native-build-ci-38724081383).

Portable native CMake/CTest 3.31.6 and Python 3.14.8 were obtained from official Kitware/PSF packages, checked against published checksums and byte-verified across all 9,400 staged files. Native version commands passed; native Git reads the expected clean checkout with process-scoped settings, without changing global configuration. [Tool provenance and exact packages](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/b0f1abe12382200cc627739f4de7ffc940b93421/attestations/qualification/ed764546/native-portable-cmake-python-prerequisites).

These supply two available native-build records; compiled alignment still admits 0/8 domains. The full native Mandatory run additionally needs the exact configured CTest/operational/recursive install recipes and reviewed root/tool relocation. A minimal export candidate is source-reviewed but remains unapplied during the active numerical experiment. No full Mandatory, native graphics/MoltenVK/UI/scientific/performance/release or ultimate-goal qualification is claimed.
